label: 탐욕의 설교를 해 준다
success_text: 상인들이 환호하며 헌금 상자를 가득 채웁니다.
success_text_en: The merchants cheer and fill the offering box.
fail_text_en: Your sermon falls flat and the merchants yawn.

label: 정직하게 장사하라고 말한다
success_text_en: The merchants leave laughing, but your heart feels light.

label: 금화로 성전을 도금한다
label_en: Gild the temple with the gold
success_text_en: Crowds gather to gawk at the gleaming temple.

label: 가난한 이들에게 나눠 준다
success_text: "바보 교주"라는 별명이 붙지만 몇몇은 눈물을 흘립니다.
success_text_en: You earn the nickname "the fool leader," yet a few weep with gratitude.

label: 경쟁을 부추긴다
success_text: 서로를 밟고 올라서려는 열기가 교단을 달굽니다.
success_text_en: Their hunger to climb over each other heats up the whole cult.
fail_text: 다툼이 번져 신도 몇이 질려 떠납니다.
fail_text_en: The feud spreads and some followers leave in disgust.

label: 셋을 불러 화해시킨다
label_en: Call them in and reconcile them
success_text: 셋은 마지못해 악수하며 당신을 무르다고 수군댑니다.
success_text_en: They shake hands grudgingly, whispering that you are soft.

label: 주빈석에서 마음껏 즐긴다
label_en: Indulge freely at the head table
success_text: 당신의 호탕한 모습이 도시의 화제가 됩니다.
success_text_en: Your lavish revelry becomes the talk of the city.
fail_text_en: You collapse from drink and are humiliated.

label: 물 한 잔만 마시고 일찍 돌아온다
label_en: Drink only water and leave early
success_text_en: A paper runs a story about "the dullest leader alive."

label: 만찬을 허락한다
success_text_en: Full-bellied laughter rings out all night.

label: 하루 한 끼 공동 식사로 제한한다
label_en: Limit it to one shared meal a day
success_text_en: An unexpected bond forms around the modest table.
fail_text_en: Followers grumble that you are stingy.

label: "야망의 장"을 늘린다
success_text: 출세를 꿈꾸는 젊은이들이 교리서를 사 갑니다.
success_text_en: Young strivers line up to buy the new scripture.

label: "인내의 장"을 늘린다
success_text: 판매는 저조하지만 쓰는 동안 마음이 고요해집니다.
success_text_en: Sales are poor, but writing it brings you calm.

label: 전액 맡긴다
success_text_en: The gamble pays off spectacularly.
fail_text_en: The banker vanishes along with the money.

label: 정중히 거절한다
success_text_en: The banker clicks his tongue and calls you a coward.

label: 은밀한 밤을 보낸다
success_text: 소문은 당신을 더욱 매혹적인 인물로 만듭니다.
success_text_en: The rumors make you all the more alluring.
fail_text_en: The meeting ends in a mess and you become a joke.

label: 편지로 정중히 사양한다
success_text_en: People start calling you "the stone leader."

label: 직접 참가해 버린다
success_text_en: The crowd goes wild over your appetite.
fail_text: 네 번째 코스에서 체해 실려 나갑니다.
fail_text_en: You choke on the fourth course and are carried out.

label: 공정하게 심사만 한다
success_text: 공정한 심사에 몇몇은 감탄하고 대부분은 지루해합니다.
success_text_en: A few admire your fairness; most are bored.

label: 출마를 선언한다
success_text: 당당한 야심에 시민들이 표를 몰아 줍니다.
success_text_en: Citizens reward your bold ambition with their votes.
fail_text_en: You lose and burn through campaign funds.

label: 다른 후보를 조용히 돕는다
success_text: 당신의 겸손을 이해하는 사람은 거의 없습니다.
success_text_en: Hardly anyone understands your humility.

label: 단식을 끝까지 이어 간다
label_en: Continue the fast to the end
success_text_en: Amid the jeers, your mind grows clear.
fail_text_en: You collapse and the papers dub you "the fool of restraint."

label: 구경꾼 앞에서 성대하게 단식을 깬다
label_en: Break the fast lavishly before the crowd
success_text_en: The crowd applauds and joins in the feasting.

label: 후원금을 보낸다
success_text_en: You are mocked, but letters from the children arrive.

label: 고아들을 신도로 받아 일을 시킨다
label_en: Take the orphans in as working followers
success_text_en: The city praises your shrewdness.
fail_text_en: The children run away and the rumors turn ugly.

label: 묵묵히 참는다
success_text_en: People read your silence as defeat.

label: 더 화려한 전단으로 반격한다
success_text_en: Your counterattack dominates street gossip.
fail_text_en: Your flyers are laughed at as childish.

label: 뇌물을 건넨다
success_text_en: People admire that you "know how things work."
fail_text_en: The deal leaks to the papers.

label: 정식 절차를 밟는다
success_text: 서류는 끝없이 밀리고 사람들은 당신을 고지식하다 합니다.
success_text_en: The paperwork drags on and people call you naive.

label: 허락하고 제막식을 연다
label_en: Allow it and hold an unveiling
success_text_en: The gleaming statue becomes a city landmark.

label: 동상 대신 우물을 파게 한다
label_en: Have them dig a well instead
success_text: 동네 사람들은 쓸모만 따지는 촌스러운 교단이라 합니다.
success_text_en: Locals call you a tacky, utilitarian cult.

label: 모임을 공식 의식으로 삼는다
success_text: 고백은 점점 대담해지고 소문이 신도를 부릅니다.
success_text_en: The confessions grow bolder, and the rumors draw newcomers.

label: 고백 대신 침묵 명상으로 바꾼다
success_text_en: In the silence, followers find unexpected peace.
fail_text_en: Calling it boring, some stop coming.

label: 그를 후계 후보로 띄운다
label_en: Promote him as a potential successor
success_text_en: Young followers flock to his fire.
fail_text_en: He begins eyeing your seat.

label: 공개 토론으로 꺾는다
success_text_en: Your logic overwhelms him.
fail_text_en: You lose the debate and your face with it.

label: 값을 치르고 거대한 벽화를 맡긴다
label_en: Pay up for a giant mural
success_text: 욕망을 찬미하는 벽화에 행인이 발을 멈춥니다.
success_text_en: Passersby stop before the mural praising desire.

label: 값을 깎아 작은 그림만 맡긴다
label_en: Haggle down to a small painting
success_text: 적은 돈으로 쓸 만한 그림을 얻습니다.
success_text_en: You get a decent painting for little money.
fail_text_en: The painter tells everyone how stingy you are.

label: 경고를 무시하고 즐긴다
success_text_en: Your followers cheer your daring.

label: 조용히 요양한다
success_text_en: Your body recovers, but rumors say you have gone soft.

label: 야심 차게 지부를 세운다
success_text_en: Your banner now flies in neighboring towns.
fail_text_en: Branch heads embezzle the funds.

label: 규모를 유지하고 내실을 다진다
success_text_en: Growth stalls, but bonds grow stronger.

label: 수완을 칭찬하고 회계를 맡긴다
label_en: Praise his skill and make him treasurer
success_text: 그는 교단 재산을 더 교묘하게 불립니다.
success_text_en: He grows the cult's wealth even more cunningly.
fail_text_en: This time he runs off with the whole vault.

label: 공개적으로 돌려받는다
success_text_en: The money returns, but the mood turns chilly.

label: 과감한 사진으로 응한다
success_text_en: The issue sells out and inquiries flood in.
fail_text_en: The photos come out ridiculous and you are mocked.

label: 미덕에 대해 진지하게 말한다
success_text_en: The interview gets shunted to the "Out of Touch" column.

label: 거울 속 자신에게 말을 건다
success_text: 거울 속 당신이 숨겨진 욕망을 일깨웁니다.
success_text_en: Your reflection awakens a hidden desire.
fail_text_en: You are haunted by voices all night.

label: 거울을 천으로 덮는다
success_text_en: The unease fades, but the curiosity lingers.

label: 화려한 행렬로 등장한다
success_text_en: Your procession steals the festival.
fail_text_en: The procession gets stuck in mud and becomes a joke.

label: 조용히 봉사 천막을 친다
label_en: Quietly set up a service tent
success_text_en: A few people are genuinely grateful.

label: 더 큰 헌신을 요구한다
success_text_en: Both offerings and obedience increase.
fail_text_en: Some turn away at your excessive demands.

label: 맹세를 거두게 한다
success_text_en: Followers are confused, yet seem more at ease.

label: 웃으며 사탕을 나눠 준다
success_text: 몇몇 아이가 머쓱해하며 사탕을 받아 갑니다.
success_text_en: A few children sheepishly take the candy.

label: 부모들에게 거세게 항의한다
success_text_en: Your force makes the parents apologize.
fail_text_en: "The saint is angry!" — and the mockery doubles.

label: 붙잡고 큰 보상을 약속한다
label_en: Hold on and promise great rewards
success_text_en: Lured by the promise, he even brings a friend.
fail_text_en: He takes the reward and leaves anyway.

label: 보내 주고 홀로 기도한다
label_en: Let him go and pray alone
success_text: 텅 빈 예배당에서 처음으로 신의 침묵을 듣습니다.
success_text_en: In the empty chapel you hear God's silence for the first time.

label: 촛불 예배를 연다
success_text: 어둠 속 촛불이 뜻밖의 분위기를 냅니다.
success_text_en: The candlelight creates an unexpected mood.

label: 부유한 후원자에게 아첨한다
success_text_en: The patron, pleased, opens his purse.
fail_text_en: Your flattery is too obvious and you are turned away.

label: 호화로운 기적 쇼를 연다
success_text_en: Fireworks and gold dust bring the faithful to their knees again.
fail_text_en: The machinery breaks and the trick is exposed.

label: 한 명씩 만나 이야기를 듣는다
success_text_en: Slowly, trust returns bit by bit.

label: 탁자를 치며 권위를 되찾는다
label_en: Slam the table and reclaim authority
success_text_en: Silence falls and all eyes turn to you.
fail_text_en: No one reacts, and you look even smaller.

label: 그의 계획을 채택해 준다
success_text: 신도들은 당신을 너그럽다 여기지만 우습게도 봅니다.
success_text_en: Followers think you generous — and a little laughable.

label: 파벌끼리 경쟁을 붙인다
label_en: Pit the factions against each other
success_text: 경쟁이 헌금을 늘리고 묘한 활력을 줍니다.
success_text_en: The competition boosts offerings and brings strange energy.
fail_text_en: A brawl breaks out and some leave.

label: 큰 솥 하나로 함께 먹게 한다
label_en: Make everyone eat from one big pot
success_text: 어색한 식사 끝에 웃음이 조금 돌아옵니다.
success_text_en: After an awkward meal, some laughter returns.

label: 밤새 교리를 새로 쓴다
success_text_en: By dawn, a rather convincing doctrine is done.
fail_text_en: You only exhaust yourself; the content is a mess.

label: 모른다고 솔직히 인정한다
success_text_en: Followers begin thinking through doctrine with you.

label: 믿는 척 열정적으로 설교한다
success_text: 신도들은 감동하지만 당신의 속은 텅 빕니다.
success_text_en: Followers are moved, but you feel empty inside.

label: 예배를 쉬고 홀로 걷는다
success_text_en: At the road's end, a faint certainty returns.
fail_text_en: Followers whisper that their leader ran away.

label: 비싼 약을 산다
success_text_en: The medicine works and you are soon on your feet.

label: 기도로 버틴다
success_text_en: The fever breaks and followers cry miracle.
fail_text_en: The illness deepens and rumors sour.

label: 독한 술로 잠을 청한다
success_text_en: The dreams fade, but mornings are heavy.

label: 측근에게 고민을 털어놓는다
success_text_en: Unburdening yourself lightens your heart.
fail_text_en: The aide spreads word of your weakness.

label: 파격적인 홍보 행사를 연다
success_text_en: The event goes viral and the coverage flips.
fail_text_en: You spend the money and no one comes.

label: 기사를 액자에 걸어 둔다
label_en: Frame the article on the wall
success_text_en: You and your followers laugh it off together.

label: 당당하게 빌린다
success_text_en: The follower lends it, wearing an odd expression.

label: 헌금에서 몰래 꺼낸다
success_text_en: No one notices.
fail_text_en: The treasurer catches you.

label: 성물을 팔아 갚는다
success_text_en: The debt is paid, but followers mourn the relic.

label: 그를 신도로 포섭한다
success_text_en: He forgives the debt and even makes an offering.
fail_text: 그가 더 크게 소리치며 소문을 냅니다.
fail_text_en: He shouts louder and spreads the story.

label: 달콤한 미래를 약속한다
success_text_en: Your vision persuades them to call off the vote.
fail_text_en: Your empty promises disappoint them more.

label: 결정을 존중하겠다고 말한다
label_en: Say you will respect their decision
success_text_en: Unexpectedly, the followers decide to stay.

label: 스캔들을 일부러 터뜨린다
success_text: 당신 이름이 다시 사람들 입에 오릅니다.
success_text_en: Your name is back on everyone's lips.
fail_text_en: Even your scandal is called boring.

label: 묵묵히 할 일을 한다
success_text_en: Your name fades, but the doctrine grows firm.

label: 마음껏 마시고 먹는다
label_en: Eat and drink to your heart's content
success_text_en: A night of endless laughter.

label: 신도들에게 건배를 돌린다
success_text_en: Followers chant your name.

label: 예복을 입고 거리를 걷는다
label_en: Stroll the streets in the robe
success_text_en: People marvel at your bearing.

label: 예배 때만 입는다
success_text_en: Worship becomes more majestic.

label: 함께 춤춘다
success_text_en: Everyone sways to the jingle of coins.

label: 보너스를 나눈다
success_text_en: New followers arrive after hearing the news.

label: 답장을 보내 격려한다
success_text_en: He shows off your letter to his friends.

label: 편지를 예배당에 걸어 둔다
label_en: Hang the letter in the chapel
success_text_en: Followers read it and steel their resolve.

label: 여유롭게 몸을 담근다
success_text_en: Your fatigue melts away.

label: 신도들에게 먼저 양보한다
success_text_en: Followers delight in your generosity.

label: 조용히 명상한다
success_text_en: Your mind settles like clear water.

label: 정원을 가꾼다
success_text_en: The smell of soil is strangely comforting.

label: 함께 빵을 나눠 먹는다
success_text_en: The simple taste lingers.

label: 신도들에게 그 이야기를 들려준다
success_text_en: Some followers' eyes grow moist.

label: 정직함을 칭찬한다
success_text_en: The merchant smiles shyly.

label: 그를 예배에 초대한다
success_text_en: He actually shows up next week.

label: 빗소리에 귀 기울인다
success_text_en: Time flows slowly.

label: 차 한 잔을 더 따른다
success_text_en: Warmth fills the room.

label: 조용히 축복한다
success_text_en: His smile spreads to you.

label: 그와 함께 산책한다
success_text_en: Your steps feel light for once.

label: 교단을 물려준다
success_text: 당신은 지팡이를 후계자에게 건네고 거울 앞을 떠납니다.
success_text_en: You pass your staff to a successor and walk away from the mirror.

label: 죽을 때까지 교단을 지킨다
success_text: 당신은 마지막 숨까지 교주로 남기로 합니다.
success_text_en: You resolve to remain leader until your last breath.
